title: vitis cinerea var. helleri
intro: Vitis cinerea var. helleri, commonly known as Heller's grape, is a plant species that belongs to the family Vitaceae. It is a woody vine native to eastern North America, known for its medicinal properties. Heller's grape has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throats, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Heller's grape include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
